items.summary: Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Microsoft Entra ID Entitlement Management allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Microsoft 安全响应中心（MSRC）发布了一则安全公告，披露 Microsoft Entra ID 的权限管理（Entitlement Management）组件存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞。该组件用于自动化身份和访问管理流程，如用户访问包的创建和审批。攻击者可通过构造特制的网络请求，触发服务端向内部或外部目标发起未经授权的HTTP请求（即SSRF），从而欺骗目标系统或服务执行非预期操作。由于SSRF漏洞可能被利用来扫描内部网络、访问内部资源或执行远程代码依赖的内部端点，攻击者可能在未授权情况下冒充其他用户身份或窃取敏感信息。目前微软尚未提供具体的CVE编号或严重性评级，但已确认该漏洞影响网络环境的安全性。建议用户密切关注MSRC后续的安全更新，并在官方补丁发布后及时应用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SSRF漏洞可被远程未授权攻击者利用，导致网络欺骗和内部资源探测，影响身份管理系统的信任基础。由于Entra ID是核心身份服务，一旦被攻破可能波及整个组织的访问控制。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1. 关注微软MSRC官方更新，及时应用补丁。2. 实施网络分段和出站请求过滤以限制SSRF利用范围。3. 审计Entra ID中的敏感操作日志，检测异常请求。4. 在未修复前，对权限管理组件加强监控和访问控制。

无披露修复版本

items.title: GitLab Patch Release: 18.11.1, 18.10.4, 18.9.6
items.summary:
On April 22, 2026, we released versions 18.11.1, 18.10.4, 18.9.6 for GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE).
These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to
one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated customers do not need to take action.
GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases. There are two types of patch releases:
scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities. Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays.
For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ.
You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here.
For security fixes, the issues detailing each vulnerability are made public on our
issue tracker
30 days after the release in which they were patched.
We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to
the highest security standards. To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers
upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version. You can read more
best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post.
Recommended Action
We strongly recommend that all installations running a version affected by the issues described below are upgraded to the latest version as soon as possible.
When no specific deployment type (omnibus, source code, helm chart, etc.) of a product is mentioned, it means all types are affected.

CVE-2026-4922 - Cross-Site Request Forgery issue in GraphQL API impacts GitLab CE/EE
GitLab has remediated an issue that could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute GraphQL mutations on behalf of authenticated users due to insufficient CSRF protection.
Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 17.0 before 18.9.6, 18.10 before 18.10.4, and 18.11 before 18.11.1 
CVSS 8.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N)
Thanks ahacker1 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
CVE-2026-5816 - Improper Resolution of Path Equivalence issue in Web IDE asset impacts GitLab CE/EE
GitLab has remediated an issue that could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in a user's browser session due to improper path validation under certain conditions.
Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 18.10 before 18.10.4 and 18.11 before 18.11.1 
CVSS 8.0 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N)
Thanks joaxcar for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program
CVE-2026-5262 - Cross-site Scripting issue in Storybook impacts GitLab CE/EE
GitLab has remediated an issue that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to access tokens in the Storybook development environment due to improper input validation.
Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/

llm_summary.summary_zh: 2026年4月22日，GitLab 发布了安全补丁版本 18.11.1、18.10.4 和 18.9.6，修复了多个安全漏洞，涵盖 GitLab Community Edition (CE) 和 Enterprise Edition (EE)。其中最严重的三个漏洞已分配 CVE 编号：CVE-2026-4922（CVSS 8.1）是一个 GraphQL API 中的跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可诱使认证用户执行恶意 GraphQL 变更操作，导致数据泄露或篡改；CVE-2026-5816（CVSS 8.0）是 Web IDE 资产中的路径等价解析不当漏洞，在特定条件下允许未经身份验证的攻击者在用户浏览器中执行任意 JavaScript，构成存储型或反射型 XSS 风险；CVE-2026-5262（CVSS 评分未提供，但标记为高严重性）是 Storybook 开发环境中的跨站脚本漏洞，可能泄露令牌等敏感信息。此外，还包括多个中等严重性的拒绝服务漏洞（影响讨论、笔记端点、Jira 导入和 GraphQL API）、会话过期不足以及访问控制缺陷，以及低严重性的 UI 层限制不当和项目派生 API 访问控制问题。受影响版本涵盖 17.0 至 18.9.5、18.10.0 至 18.10.3、18.11.0。GitLab.com 已自动更新，自管理实例需尽快升级。GitLab Dedicated 客户无需操作。官方公告中未披露漏洞利用细节，但强烈建议所有自管理用户立即升级。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GitLab 广泛用于企业 DevSecOps 流程，本次修补的高危 CSRF 与 XSS 漏洞可导致敏感数据泄露或账户接管，中危 DoS 漏洞可能影响服务可用性，升级刻不容缓。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 立即将自管理的 GitLab 实例升级至 18.11.1、18.10.4 或 18.9.6 版本；检查资产清单确认受影响版本；关注 GitLab 官方安全公告获取后续细节。
limitations: 公告未提供所有修复漏洞的 CVE 编号及详细技术描述
CVSS 评分仅对部分漏洞公开
